'''Volume 1''' is the first volume published by [[VIZ Media]] compiling chapters from the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga created by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. The chapters in this volume are collected directly from the magazine publication of Pokémon Adventures and are collected independently of [[Shogakukan]]'s collected releases of the magazine version. 

==Blurb==
''Sun dreams of money. Moon dreams of scientific discoveries. When their paths cross with Team Skull, both their plans go awry...''

''Moon is on her way to deliver a rare Pokémon to Professor Kukui in the Alola region when she meets his good friend Sun, a courier entrusted with a special Pokédex. Sun offers to safely deliver Moon to the professor's lab... But then they tangle with a group of grunts from Team Skull and are attacked by a mysterious Pokémon!''

==Major events==
{{spoilers}}
* Moon arrives in Alola with the goal of delivering a {{p|Rotom}} to Professor Kukui
* Moon meets Sun on the beach, who is tossing {{p|Pyukumuku}} into the ocean
* Team Skull accuses Sun of not finishing the job, and picks a fight with Sun and Moon
* Sun announces his goal is to save up a million dollars
* Sun and Moon travel to Professor Kukui's house in Hau'oli City
* Moon makes medicine using fruits she shot out of a tree using a bow and arrow and heals Sun's broken leg
* {{p|Tapu Koko}} appears out of the sky
* After Sun tries battling the {{p|Tapu Koko}} it shoots into the sky, leaving behind a Sparkling Stone
* At the Professor's house Moon delivers her {{p|Rotom}} to the Professor, who refuses to enter Sun's Pokédex because it's stinky and dirty
* The Island Kahunas battle discuss that the Tapus are angry, and hope a battle festival with the young trainers of Alola will produce a winner that can calm their anger
* Moon receives a Rowlet from the Professor
* Sun prepares deliveries for the battle festival
* Sun is approached by Professor Kukui, who is mad at Sun for not reporting his sighting of {{p|Tapu Koko}} to Kahuna Hala, and signs Sun up for the battle festival to make up for this mistake
